environment.description: Lambda function deployed with identical code. API Gateway endpoint type set to PRIVATE with resource policy restricting invoke to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.execute-api) is configured in subnet-abc123 within VPC vpc-0def456 with security group sg-09876 allowing inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.8.0/24 (internal service mesh subnet). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway on the service mesh subnet, and no VPC peering to any VPC with public egress. Route table rtb-aaa111 for subnet-abc123 has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16) and the VPCE prefix list. DNS resolution for the API Gateway execute-api domain resolves only to the private VPCE ENI IPs within the VPC. No public DNS resolution is possible for the stage URL outside this VPC.

config.vpc_config: No IGW, no NAT on 10.0.8.0/24 subnet, no peering with public-routable VPCs
config.route_table: rtb-aaa111: local 10.0.0.0/16 only + pl-vpce prefix list
config.callers: Only internal ECS tasks in service mesh (10.0.8.0/24) with mTLS sidecar
